decisions.reason: A single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core offer in a growing industry, and the firm is expanding and has the slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.
This condenser is close to the established offer and fits the firm's push toward efficiency, but it overlaps with Product C, so there is some chance the two are consolidated.
Product C is nearly identical to Product B and is the more likely of the two to be merged, yet the firm's slack and expansion give little reason to drop it now.
The tube liner is a lifecycle repair product that supports the firm's service strategy, and service products typically meet aspirations with steady aftermarket demand.
A customized multi-model air cooler line matches the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and is costly to abandon, so there is no shortfall prompting search.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the firm's spare-parts and repair business, which tends to be stable and profitable, so the firm keeps them.
